games-the-legend-of-zelda-breath-of-the-.description: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild is a 2017 action-adventure game developed by Nintendo EPD for the Wii U and Nintendo Switch. Set near the end of the Zelda timeline, it follows Link as he sets out to save Princess Zelda and prevent Calamity Ganon from destroying the world.
games-the-legend-of-zelda-breath-of-the-.descriptionTitle: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

games-baldurs-gate-3.description: Baldur's Gate 3 is a role-playing video game by Larian Studios. It is the third installment in the Baldur's Gate series.

games-stardew-valley.description: Stardew Valley is a 2016 farm life simulation video game developed by Eric "ConcernedApe" Barone. Players take the role of a character who inherits their deceased grandfather's dilapidated farm.

games-persona-5.description: Persona 5 is a 2016 role-playing video game developed by P-Studio. The game is the sixth installment in the Persona series, itself a spin-off from the Megami Tensei franchise.

games-crusader-kings-iii.description: Crusader Kings III is a grand strategy role-playing video game set in the Middle Ages, developed by Paradox Development Studio and published by Paradox Interactive as a sequel to Crusader Kings (2004) and Crusader Kings II (2012), featuring similar gameplay, centred around historical bloodlines and dynasties. The game was released on PC on 1 September 2020 and on the Xbox Series X/S and PlayStation 5 on 29 March 2022 in most regions.

games-cyberpunk-2077.description: Cyberpunk 2077 is a 2020 action role-playing game developed by CD Projekt Red and published by CD Projekt. Based on and set in the fictional universe of Mike Pondsmith's Cyberpunk tabletop game series, Cyberpunk 2077 takes place in the dystopian metropolis of Night City in California.

games-disco-elysium-the-final-cut.description: Disco Elysium is a 2019 role-playing video game by ZA/UM. The game was written and designed by a team led by Estonian novelist Robert Kurvitz and executive producer Kaur Kender, featuring a painterly art style and music by the English band Sea Power.

games-uncharted-waters-new-horizons.description: Uncharted Waters, originally released as Daikoukai Jidai , is a Japanese business simulation/strategy/role-playing video game series produced by Koei under its "Rekoeition" brand, themed around seafaring adventures during the Age of Discovery. In the games, the player takes up the role of a captain and manages a seagoing fleet to participate in trades, privateering, treasure hunting, exploration and plain piracy.

games-resident-evil-4.description: Resident Evil 4 is a 2005 survival horror game developed and published by Capcom for the GameCube. Players control the special agent Leon S.

games-the-legend-of-sword-and-fairy-4.description: The Legend of Sword and Fairy 4, also known as Sword and Fairy 4 (仙劍四) or Chinese Paladin 4, is a xianxia-themed fantasy adventure role-playing video game developed by Taiwanese game company Softstar Entertainment's Shanghai subsidiary and released in 2007. It is the fifth installment in The Legend of Sword and Fairy video game series, and serves as an independent prequel to the third game.
games-the-legend-of-sword-and-fairy-4.descriptionTitle: The Legend of Sword and Fairy 4

movies-coco.description: Coco is a 2017 American animated fantasy film directed by Lee Unkrich, and written by Adrian Molina and Matthew Aldrich. Produced by Pixar Animation Studios for Walt Disney Pictures, the film stars the voices of Anthony Gonzalez, Gael García Bernal, Benjamin Bratt, Alanna Ubach, Renée Victor, Ana Ofelia Murguía and Edward James Olmos.

movies-flipped.description: Flipped is a 2010 American romantic comedy-drama film co-written and directed by Rob Reiner, and based on Wendelin Van Draanen's 2001 novel of the same name. Starring Callan McAuliffe, Madeline Carroll, Rebecca De Mornay, Anthony Edwards, John Mahoney, Penelope Ann Miller, Aidan Quinn, and Kevin Weisman.

movies-howls-moving-castle.description: Howl's Moving Castle is a 2004 Japanese animated fantasy film written and directed by Hayao Miyazaki, based on Diana Wynne Jones' 1986 novel. The film was produced by Toshio Suzuki, animated by Studio Ghibli, and distributed by Toho.

movies-the-truman-show.description: The Truman Show is a 1998 American comedy-drama film directed by Peter Weir, and written and co-produced by Andrew Niccol. It stars Jim Carrey as Truman Burbank, a man who is unaware that he is living on a colossal soundstage, and that his life is the subject of a reality television show.

movies-interstellar.description: Interstellar is a 2014 epic science fiction drama film directed by Christopher Nolan, who co-wrote the screenplay with his brother, Jonathan Nolan. It features an ensemble cast led by Matthew McConaughey, Anne Hathaway, Jessica Chastain, Bill Irwin, Ellen Burstyn, and Michael Caine.

movies-the-lord-of-the-rings.description: Peter Jackson's film trilogy adapts Tolkien's Middle-earth story across The Fellowship of the Ring (2001), The Two Towers (2002) and The Return of the King (2003). It follows the struggle to destroy the One Ring.
movies-the-lord-of-the-rings.descriptionTitle: The Lord of the Rings film trilogy

movies-the-reluctant-fundamentalist.description: The Reluctant Fundamentalist is a 2013 American political thriller drama film directed by Mira Nair and starring Riz Ahmed, Kate Hudson, and Liev Schreiber. It is based on the 2007 novel of the same name by Mohsin Hamid.

movies-maharaja.description: Maharaja is a 2024 Indian Tamil -language neo-noir action thriller film directed by Nithilan Saminathan. Produced by The Route, Think Studios and Passion Studios, the film stars Vijay Sethupathi, alongside Anurag Kashyap and Sachana Namidass.

drama-love-death-robots.description: Love, Death & Robots is an adult animated anthology web series created by Tim Miller for Netflix. Although the series is produced by Blur Studio, its individual episodes are drawn from the work of an international variety of animation studios.

drama-cyberpunk-edgerunners.description: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners  is an original net animation (ONA) miniseries created by Rafał Jaki. It was co-produced by the Polish video game company CD Projekt Red and the Japanese animation studio Trigger, and premiered on Netflix on September 13, 2022.

drama-the-queens-gambit.description: The Queen's Gambit is a 2020 American coming-of-age period drama television miniseries based on the 1983 eponymous novel by Walter Tevis. The title refers to the "Queen's Gambit", a chess opening.

drama-gin-tama.description: Gintama  is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Hideaki Sorachi. It was serialized in Shueisha's shōnen manga magazine Weekly Shōnen Jump from December 2003 to September 2018, later in Jump Giga from December 2018 to February 2019, and concluded on the Gintama app, where it ran from May to June 2019.

drama-doraemon.description: Doraemon  is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Fujiko F. Fujio.

books-les-miserables.description: Les Misérables is a French epic historical novel by Victor Hugo, first published on 31 March 1862, that is considered one of the greatest novels of the 19th century. Les Misérables has been popularized through numerous adaptations for film, television, and the stage, including a musical.

books-a-thousand-splendid-suns.description: A Thousand Splendid Suns is a 2007 novel by Afghan-American author Khaled Hosseini, following the huge success of his bestselling 2003 debut The Kite Runner. Mariam, an illegitimate teenager from Herat, is forced to marry a shoemaker from Kabul after a family tragedy.

books-to-live.description: To Live is a novel written by Chinese novelist Yu Hua in 1993. It follows the life of Xu Fugui as he transforms from the selfish idling son of a wealthy landowner to a solitary peasant during the Chinese Communist Revolution.

books-tristan-and-iseult.description: Tristan and Iseult, also known as Tristan and Isolde and other names, is a medieval legend told in numerous variations since the 12th century. Of disputed source, usually assumed to be primarily Celtic, the tale is a tragedy about the illicit love between the Cornish knight Tristan and the Irish princess Iseult in the days of King Arthur.

books-kinder-und-hausmarchen.description: Grimms' Fairy Tales, originally known as the Children's and Household Tales, is a German collection of fairy tales by the Brothers Grimm, Jacob and Wilhelm, first published on 20 December 1812. Vol. 1 of the first edition contained 86 stories, which were followed by 70 more tales, numbered consecutively, in the 1st edition, Vol. 2, in 1815.

music-bohemian-rhapsody.description: "Bohemian Rhapsody" is the penultimate song from British rock band Queen's fourth studio album, A Night at the Opera. It is a suite composed of five main elements: an introduction, a ballad, an opera, a hard rock segment, and a reflective coda.

music-we-are-the-champions.description: "We Are the Champions" is a song by the British rock band Queen, released from the band's sixth album News of the World (1977). Written by lead singer Freddie Mercury, it remains one of rock's most recognisable anthems.

music-lemon.description: "Lemon" is a song by Japanese singer-songwriter Kenshi Yonezu, released as a single through Sony Music Entertainment Japan on March 14, 2018. It is the theme song for the TV series Unnatural.

group-queen.description: Queen are a British rock band formed in London in 1970 by Freddie Mercury, Brian May, and Roger Taylor, and later joined by John Deacon (bass). Their earliest works were influenced by progressive rock, hard rock and heavy metal, but the band gradually ventured into more conventional and radio-friendly works by incorporating further styles, such as arena rock and pop rock.

person-kenshi-yonezu.description: Kenshi Yonezu  is a Japanese singer-songwriter, musician, producer, and illustrator. He started releasing Vocaloid music under the stage name Hachi (ハチ) in 2009.

studio-ghibli.description: Studio Ghibli Inc.  is a Japanese animation studio based in Koganei, Tokyo. It was founded on June 15, 1985, by directors Hayao Miyazaki and Isao Takahata and producer Toshio Suzuki, after acquiring Topcraft's assets.

studio-pixar.description: Pixar, doing business as Pixar Animation Studios, is an American animation studio based in Emeryville, California, known for its critically and commercially successful computer-animated feature films. Pixar is a subsidiary of Walt Disney Studios, a division of the Disney Entertainment segment of the Walt Disney Company.

movies-ratatouille.description: Ratatouille is a 2007 American animated comedy-drama film written and directed by Brad Bird, from a story by Jan Pinkava, Jim Capobianco and Bird. Produced by Pixar Animation Studios for Walt Disney Pictures, the film stars the voices of Patton Oswalt, Lou Romano, Ian Holm, Janeane Garofalo, Peter O'Toole, Brian Dennehy, Peter Sohn and Brad Garrett.

foods-ramen.description: Ramen   is a Japanese-Chinese fusion noodle dish. It includes Chinese-style alkaline wheat noodles  served in several flavors of hot broth.
foods-ramen.artworkNote: Representative subject imagery; not a personal photograph or experience claim.

foods-sushi.description: Sushi  is a traditional Japanese dish made with vinegared rice , typically seasoned with sugar and salt, and combined with a variety of ingredients , such as seafood, vegetables, or meat; raw seafood is the most common, although some may be cooked. While sushi has numerous styles and presentations, the current defining component is the vinegared rice, also known as shari (しゃり), or sumeshi (酢飯).
foods-sushi.artworkNote: Representative subject imagery; not a personal photograph or experience claim.

foods-hot-pot.description: Hot pot or hotpot, also known as steamboat, is a dish of soup or stock kept simmering in a pot by a heat source on the table, accompanied by an array of raw meats, vegetables and soy-based foods which diners quickly cook by dipping in the broth.
foods-hot-pot.artworkNote: Representative subject imagery; not a personal photograph or experience claim.

topics-analytical-psychology.description: Analytical psychology is a term referring to the psychological practices of Carl Jung. It was designed to distinguish it from Freud's psychoanalytic theories as their seven-year collaboration on psychoanalysis was drawing to an end between 1912 and 1913.
topics-analytical-psychology.artworkNote: Hk kng's diagram of Jung's psychological functions, adapted from Jolande Jacobi, illustrates the topic; this is not a Jung portrait or a book in the personal collection.

topics-existentialism.description: Existentialism is a family of philosophical views and inquiry that explore the human individual's struggle to lead an authentic life despite the apparent absurdity or incomprehensibility of existence. In examining meaning, purpose, and value, existentialist thought often includes concepts such as existential crises, angst, courage, and the curse and blessing of human freedom.
topics-existentialism.artworkNote: A portrait of Jean-Paul Sartre illustrates existentialist philosophy.

topics-cosmology.description: Cosmology is the study of the nature of the universe, the cosmos. The term cosmology was first used in English in 1656 in Thomas Blount's Glossographia, with the meaning of "a speaking of the world".
topics-cosmology.artworkNote: The Hubble eXtreme Deep Field illustrates cosmology.

topics-socionics.description: In psychology and sociology, socionics is a pseudoscientific theory of information processing and personality types. It incorporates Carl Jung's work on Psychological Types with Antoni Kępiński's theory of information metabolism.
topics-socionics.artworkNote: A portrait of Aušra Augustinavičiūtė illustrates the history of socionics.

music-fujii-kaze.description: Fujii Kaze is a Japanese singer-songwriter and pianist. He began sharing piano covers online as a child before releasing his debut album HELP EVER HURT NEVER in 2020.

music-matsuri.description: Matsuri is a Fujii Kaze song from LOVE ALL SERVE ALL (2022). Kaze wrote the song, with production by Yaffle.
music-matsuri.artworkNote: The LOVE ALL SERVE ALL album artwork represents its song Matsuri; this does not add another album to the collection.

music-kirari.description: Kirari is a 2021 single by Fujii Kaze. It also opens his second album, LOVE ALL SERVE ALL.

topics-carl-jung.description: Carl Gustav Jung was a Swiss psychiatrist and the founder of analytical psychology. His writing explored archetypes, the collective unconscious, and psychological types.

music-another-one-bites-the-dust.description: Another One Bites the Dust is a Queen song written by bassist John Deacon. It appears on the band's 1980 album The Game and is built around Deacon's prominent bass line.
music-another-one-bites-the-dust.descriptionTitle: Another One Bites the Dust — Queen

movies-disney.description: Disney spans animated films, live-action storytelling, characters and theme parks. Its history began with Walt and Roy Disney's animation studio in 1923.

movies-spider-man-2002.description: Sam Raimi's 2002 film stars Tobey Maguire as Peter Parker, a young man who becomes Spider-Man after a spider bite. Willem Dafoe plays the Green Goblin.

movies-ben-hur-1959.description: William Wyler's 1959 epic follows Judah Ben-Hur, played by Charlton Heston, through betrayal, enslavement and a quest for justice. Its story includes a climactic chariot race.

foods-jiro-ramen.description: Ramen Jiro is a Tokyo-born ramen chain associated with generous portions, thick noodles and a rich broth. Its distinctive bowls are the origin of the broader Jiro-style ramen family.
foods-jiro-ramen.artworkNote: A publicly sourced Ramen Jiro bowl illustrates the brand and style; not a personal meal photograph.

foods-otoro.description: Otoro is the highly fatty belly cut of tuna, often served as sushi or sashimi. Its marbling gives it a rich, soft texture.

foods-yakiniku.description: Yakiniku is a Japanese style of barbecue in which small pieces of meat are grilled and eaten a few at a time. A tabletop grill is a familiar part of the experience.
foods-yakiniku.artworkNote: A public yakiniku photograph represents the food; not a personal meal photograph.

foods-wagyu.description: Wagyu refers to Japanese cattle breeds and the beef produced from them. Rich intramuscular marbling is a distinctive feature of many wagyu cuts.
foods-wagyu.artworkNote: Kobe beef, a regional type of wagyu, illustrates marbled Japanese beef; not a personal meal or brand preference claim.

foods-beef-tongue.description: Beef tongue is a cut used in many cuisines. In Japanese yakiniku it is commonly sliced and grilled; grilled gyutan is also closely associated with Sendai.

movies-the-fellowship-of-the-ring.description: The 2001 opening film follows Frodo Baggins and a fellowship formed to take the One Ring toward Mordor. Peter Jackson directs the beginning of the trilogy's journey.

movies-the-two-towers.description: The 2002 middle chapter follows a divided fellowship, Frodo and Sam's uneasy alliance with Gollum, and the defense of Rohan. Peter Jackson returns as director.

movies-the-return-of-the-king.description: The 2003 conclusion follows the last battles for Middle-earth while Frodo and Sam try to reach Mount Doom. Peter Jackson brings the trilogy's parallel journeys to their ending.

games-resident-evil-series.description: Capcom's Resident Evil games combine survival horror with stories of biological outbreaks. The collection shown here includes Resident Evil 2, Resident Evil 4, Village and Requiem.
